summary: Hands-on HVAC/R Technician with diploma-level training and field experience in residential and light commercial system service. Skilled in refrigerant recovery, electrical diagnostics, and customer-facing service work. OSHA 10 certified with demonstrated competency across split systems, package units, and ductless mini-splits.

education.degree: Diploma, Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technician

experience.title: HVAC Apprentice
bullets: Supported lead technicians on 15-20 residential and light commercial service calls per week, including AC installations, heat pump swaps, and emergency repair work
Logged refrigerant pressures, electrical readings, and airflow measurements to warranty and manufacturer specifications
Maintained clean job sites and customer-facing communication during multi-day install projects

experience.title: Facilities Maintenance Technician
bullets: Performed weekly preventive maintenance across four school facilities, including filter replacement, thermostat calibration, and condensate line clearing
Identified equipment deficiencies and submitted work orders to facilities director for capital planning
Coordinated with custodial staff to minimize disruption during occupied-hour service windows

skills: Split system and package unit service
